notional_basis: NAV: a $N rung sells N / 1.2199676264 sfrxUSD (pps_x_chainlink_frxusd_usd); input_amount is shares
excluded_sources_basis: Frax's frxUSD->USDC custodian (exchange 'frxusd') is frxUSD's primary redemption, not secondary depth for sfrxUSD; sfrxUSD's own primary route (Hop -> Fraxtal mint/redeemer, paid in frxUSD) is not an Ethereum venue and is published in sfrxusd_backing.json asset_specific.sfrxusd.primary_exit
reference_basis: smallest SUCCESSFUL rung; size and marginal impact are measured against its rate

cost_conventions.all_in_cost_bps: 1 - USDC out / nav_notional_usd, USDC at face. nav_notional_usd = input shares x usd_per_share (see nav_convention). Standing spread included, gas excluded
cost_conventions.all_in_cost_bps_incl_gas: as all_in_cost_bps with KyberSwap's gasUsd estimate deducted from output
cost_conventions.size_impact_bps: 1 - average rate / reference rate. HEADLINE basis
cost_conventions.marginal_impact_bps: 1 - (delta USDC / delta nav_notional_usd since the previous successful rung) / reference rate
cost_conventions.all_in_cost_bps_vs_face_nav: 1 - USDC out / (input shares x PPS x $1 per frxUSD): the same quote against the frxUSD face-value convention the 2026-10-15 research used

headline.value_basis: the last rung that clears; the crossing lies inside bracket_usd and is not interpolated

headline_basis: 50 bps of size impact is the stable-asset headline

marginal_at_headline_bps.value_basis: the last rung that clears; the crossing lies inside bracket_usd and is not interpolated

context_200bps.value_basis: the last rung that clears; the crossing lies inside bracket_usd and is not interpolated

context_200bps_note: secondary context only, never the headline

last_valid_headline.value_basis: the last rung that clears; the crossing lies inside bracket_usd and is not interpolated

last_valid_headline_basis: this run's headline when it located a crossing, bracket or floor; otherwise the previous artifact's, with its own measured_at. A failed run does not erase it
route_venues_scope: pools KyberSwap selected for these exact rungs, deduplicated by (exchange, pool). Executable route evidence, NOT a venue inventory: DexTracker publishes inventory and its filter diagnostics in data/liquidity/sfrxusd_liquidity.json (DexTracker; requested, not yet published)
scope: canonical Ethereum only; every other network is unmeasured here

staging.basis: not in any backing-monitor source root; promote only after review

input_unit: sfrxUSD shares (input_amount); size_usd is the declared NAV notional

nav_sizing.pps_source: sfrxUSD.pricePerShare() at the context block (administered formula, not a market price)
nav_sizing.nav_convention_basis: usd_per_share = PPS 1.2202073606 frxUSD x Chainlink frxUSD/USD 0.99980353 (updatedAt 2026-11-11T21:36:47Z)

reference_price_feed_basis: Chainlink frxUSD/USD, USDT/USD and USDC/USD read at the context block with their updatedAt; PPS from sfrxUSD.pricePerShare() at that block
cadence: every third hour at :35 (00, 03, ... 21 local), via run_backing_analyzers.sh

max_input_age.quotes: a headline uses only this run's successful quotes; a failed run keeps last_valid_headline with its own measured_at

quote_limitations: router estimates from KyberSwap /routes, not executed fills; no expiry is returned. A successful largest rung is a floor, not a precise maximum exit

curve_research_route.label: DIAGNOSTIC -- research route, never the dollar headline
curve_research_route.method: read-only Curve get_dy at ONE pinned block, sequential: sfrxUSD->frxUSD in 0xF292eB6c5dcb693Eaaf392D0562a01C3710E5978 (i=0, j=1), then that frxUSD output -> USDT in 0xD6937eA8D33B0C21348F36F7895FdE3054bA4927 (i=0, j=1). Pool fees included; gas, approvals and optimal routing excluded
curve_research_route.frxusd_leg_units: frxUSD (output_frxusd); cost vs PPS in frxUSD terms -- NOT a dollar exit
curve_research_route.treasury_owned_basis: the sfrxUSD controller owned ~99.9998% / 99.9948% of these two pools' LP on 2026-10-15 (riskAnalyst review); current ownership is DexTracker's
